sections.heading: Lesson Learning Outcomes
sections.lead: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to:

items.text: Recall the standard form of a quadratic equation.
Solve a quadratic equation using the quadratic formula.
Apply related formulas to real-world problems.

sections.heading: Same formula via the MathJax engine (SVG)

items.label: Quadratic formula — MathJax to self-contained SVG

sections.heading: Worked example
sections.body: Solve $x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0$. Here $a = 1$, $b = -5$, $c = 6$, so the discriminant is $\Delta = 25 - 24 = 1$, and the quadratic formula gives $x = 2$ or $x = 3$.

items.text: Write the quadratic formula from memory.
